GEMWORLD,
A HAVEN FOR US
BELOW THE MAIN
LANDS. AMETHYST,
TOPAZ...
MADE FROM A CRY'STAL FORMED NEAR THE MOOTH CORE OF THE EARTH. IT REFRICTS EVERYTHING EVENGE EVE EVE E EVE STA STAT ERE E CH EATA
WE'VE BEEN SAFE HERE, UNTIL NOW.

DIANA,
I DON'T
UNDERSTAND
WHAT HAPPENED
OUT THERE,
DIANA.
IT'S SIMPLE, BRUCE. WHAT HAPPENED IS WE LOST. IT'S OVER.

WHAT
DOES MATTER IS
YOU'RE HERE AND
YOU CAN COME
WITH US.
YOU CAN HELP US PROTECT THEM.
